content.value:
GamepadEx wraps a gamepad and provides GamepadButton objects for each button.

A GamepadButton monitors the physical button and can automatically schedule a command when pressed.

This is called button binding.

Declare a private GamepadEx field called driver.

In initialize(), create it with: driver = new GamepadEx(gamepad1).

Declare a private DcMotor field for motor.

In initialize(), get "front_left_motor" from hardwareMap.

Use driver.getGamepadButton(GamepadKeys.Button.A).whenPressed() to schedule an InstantCommand when A is pressed.

The InstantCommand sets the motor to 1.0.

whenPressed() fires on the rising edge — the moment the button goes from not pressed to pressed.

steps.title: Start the OpMode and press A

content.value:
Add a second binding: driver.getGamepadButton(GamepadKeys.Button.B).whenPressed() with an InstantCommand that stops the motor.

Now A starts it, B stops it.

whileHeld() is another option — it runs a command while held and cancels on release.
